job.title: Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH

tailoring.headline: Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in headless, composable e-commerce, designing REST/OCC APIs, PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, and data pipelines. Strong Java, Spring, microservices, and CI/CD background. Proven techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, and stakeholder management across international teams. Skilled in AI-assisted development, performance tuning, and production support.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
cover_en.hook: I am excited by your ambition to lead retail and CPG digital commerce across the DACH region. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless, composable e-commerce architectures that align perfectly with your strategic goals.

bullets.label: E-commerce platform expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce solutions, including product catalog, pricing and order management, supporting B2B and B2C retail scenarios.

bullets.label: Headless API development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs that powered storefronts and third-party integrations, ensuring fast, scalable commerce experiences.

bullets.label: Integration & data pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks for global product synchronization.

bullets.label: Techno-functional consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and solution designs, driving successful releases in agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15 December 2026, with earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your digital commerce vision.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant - Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
cover_de.hook: Ihre Vorreiterrolle im digitalen Handel für Retail- und CPG-Kunden in der DACH-Region begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in headless und composable E-Commerce-Architekturen mit, das exakt zu Ihrer Strategie passt.

bullets.label: E-Commerce-Plattform-Kompetenz
bullets.text: Konzipierte und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce-Lösungen für Produktkatalog, Preisgestaltung und Order Management in B2B- und B2C-Umgebungen.

bullets.label: Headless-API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie headless APIs, die Storefronts und Drittanbieter-Integrationen performant unterstützen.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Entwickelte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders und löste ERP/MDM-Integrationsengpässe für globale Produktabgleiche.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, übersetzte Anforderungen in User Stories, funktionale Spezifikationen und Lösungsdesigns und steuerte erfolgreiche Releases im agilen Umfeld.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist (frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026). Gerne erläutere ich in einem Gespräch, wie ich Ihre Digital-Commerce-Strategie voranbringen kann.

tailoring.why_company: Your company’s commitment to shaping the future of retail and CPG commerce through composable, headless solutions aligns with my passion for building scalable, AI-enhanced e-commerce platforms. I am impressed by your innovative ecosystem, strong market presence in the DACH region, and focus on customer-centric digital experiences – a perfect match for my SAP Commerce expertise and techno-functional consulting background.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help you accelerate DACH retail and CPG digital commerce with my proven SAP Commerce, headless API, and integration experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years in retail & CPG e-commerce. I’m eager to discuss how I can add value to your Digital Commerce team. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce (Retail & CPG) | DACH
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant – Digital Commerce role. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, strong headless API expertise, and proven techno-functional consulting skills. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards
